name: Zheng Qinwen
intro: Zheng Qinwen is an Olympic champion from China. In China the family name comes first, so friends call her Qinwen. She won gold at the 2024 Paris Olympics, and fans call her Queen Wen.
story: At age eight Qinwen moved away from home to train in a bigger city. At eleven she watched Li Na win the Australian Open on TV. She says Li Na planted dream seeds inside her. This year she was a qualifier, winning extra matches just to get in. Now she says she has found her fire again!

funFacts.text: She loves roller coasters. The highest point makes her feel free.
She loves karaoke. She sings slow Chinese songs and even some Chinese rap.
She is a big fan of the K-pop group Blackpink.
She was the first Asian player ever to win Olympic gold in singles.
Her forehand spun about 2,800 times a minute at one tournament. More than any other woman there!
She lives and trains in Barcelona, Spain.
Her hero is Li Na, the first Chinese player to win one of the four biggest tournaments.

watchFor: Watch her huge serve and her heavy-spinning forehand jump up high off the court.
